front_matter.description: A place at a quay where one vessel moors.

markdown:
A place at a quay where one vessel moors. ## Depends on - [quay](./quay.mdx) · layer 1 · shore · 4 references ## Used by - [vessel](../2-craft/vessel.mdx) · layer 2 · craft · 4 references ## Entities ### Berth Identified by `berth_id` (`BerthId`). | field | type | |---|---| | `quay_id` | `QuayId` | | `started_at` | `timestamp` | Relations: - `quay_id` references **Quay** of [quay](./quay.mdx) (one, by `quay_id`) ## Commands ### RetireBerth **Retire a berth.** | field | type | |---|---| | `berth_id` | `BerthId` | | `at` | `timestamp` | | outcome | when | result | |---|---|---| | `no-such-berth` (refused) | no such Berth | `BerthNotFound`: No berth of this identity exists. | | `retired` | otherwise | moves the **Berth** `Active` → `Retired`; emits `BerthRetired` | | `wrong-state` (refused) | the Berth is in a state that does not allow it | `BerthStateConflict`: The berth is not in a state this command acts from. | ### StartBerth **Start a berth.** | field | type | |---|---| | `berth_id` | `BerthId` | | `quay_id` | `QuayId` | | `at` | `timestamp` | | outcome | when | result | |---|---|---| | `started` | otherwise | creates a **Berth** in `Active`; emits `BerthStarted` | ## Events | event | fields | emitted by | |---|---|---| | `BerthRetired` | `berth_id` BerthId, `at` timestamp | `RetireBerth` | | `BerthStarted` | `berth_id` BerthId, `at` timestamp | `StartBerth` | ## Views | view | rows | fields | |---|---|---| | `Berths`
